why: Third measured occurrence (2026-10-19, Discovery report) of worker-temp-file-collided-across-sessions: writers told to delete the scratch scripts after removed the orchestrator's provision.mjs, engram-save.mjs, mirror-odd.mjs, split-backlog.mjs and contrast.mjs from the shared session scratchpad root. shared-temp-guard stops a delegated agent writing into the shared TEMP root; this guard stops it deleting a file it did not create. Authorship is recorded by effect in a per-agent journal: on Bash and PowerShell the guard judges a deletion and records what the call creates; on Write and MultiEdit it only records. The main session is never judged.
